 About the Role

 


 We are seeking a highly technical AI Systems & Solutions Architect to help define the next generation of Intel datacenter platforms for AI workloads, including Generative AI and Agentic AI.

You will combine customer evidence, workload analysis, and hands-on technical investigation to help ensure future Intel platforms and Xeon processors address real-world AI requirements and new opportunities for CPU and platform innovation.


 Success in this role requires excellent customer engagement and communication skills, deep technical expertise, strong architectural judgment, and a proven track record of influencing decisions across customers, architects, product teams, and engineering organizations.

  Translate customer evidence and technical findings into product requirements, architecture recommendations, workload optimizations, and platform enhancements.

Providence Equity Partners L.L.C. is a leading middle-market private equity firm with deep sector expertise in media, communications and education focused on North America and Europe. To learn more, please visit www.provequity.com.





Position Overview
The AI Solutions Architect is responsible for applying AI technologies to solve high-value business problems across PEP and its portfolio companies. This role will join the Firm's Portfolio Operations team and partners with IT, Investment, Finance, Operations, and other business teams to understand business needs, identify where AI can meaningfully improve outcomes, and translate those opportunities into practical, secure, and scalable solutions.



The AI Solutions Architect will lead the evaluation, configuration, integration, and implementation of AI-enabled solutions using commercially available AI models, platforms, and enterprise technologies. The role will guide initiatives from opportunity identification and solution design through implementation, adoption, measurement, and continuous improvement. Success in this role requires strong technical fluency, business judgment, and the ability to translate business needs into practical solutions while ensuring appropriate security, privacy, governance, and responsible AI controls.



Responsibilities 
The AI Solutions Architect will be responsible for the following:

Partner with IT, Investment, Finance, Operations, and other business teams to understand business processes, identify high-value opportunities for AI, and prioritize initiatives based on business value, feasibility, risk, and scalability.

Translate business needs into practical AI-enabled solutions by evaluating available technologies and determining how existing AI tools, platforms, and enterprise capabilities can be applied to improve productivity, decision-making, operational effectiveness, or financial outcomes.

Design solution approaches that leverage existing AI capabilities, including generative AI platforms, intelligent agents, enterprise search, workflow automation, and other commercially available technologies.

Leverage current, commercially available AI solutions within existing business processes and enterprise systems, including Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Slack, Workday, DealCloud, and other firm and portfolio company platforms to solve prioritized business cases. Where an existing solution is not the best fit, recommend alternative AI approaches.

Evaluate AI models, platforms, applications, and third-party solutions and make recommendations based on business requirements, functionality, ease of implementation, integration needs, cost, security, scalability, and operational risk.

Determine the appropriate solution approach, including when to leverage an existing enterprise capability, configure a commercial AI product, integrate multiple technologies, or use a non-AI solution when it better addresses the business need.

Lead AI initiatives from business problem definition through implementation and adoption, coordinating solution design, configuration, integration, testing, stakeholder engagement, rollout, monitoring, and ongoing enhancement.

Establish reusable solution patterns, implementation approaches, and playbooks that enable successful AI use cases to be replicated and scaled across business functions and portfolio companies.

Define and monitor measures of solution effectiveness and business impact, including adoption, productivity improvement, financial value, and return on investment, and use results to guide enhancements and future priorities.

8+ years of relevant professional experience in technology solutions, enterprise applications, digital transformation, technology consulting, systems integration, software solutions, product management. engineering management or a related field, with recent professional experience focused on applying AI technologies to business problems and implementing AI-enabled solutions.

Define business outcomes, functional requirements, user journeys, and acceptance criteria for enterprise and manufacturing AI use cases; collaborate with BTS and technical teams on solution design rather than acting as the primary hands-on technical architect.

Support change management and capability building by advising stakeholders, promoting adoption, and sharing best practices across engineering and operations. job_highlights.title: Qualifications
items: Qualifications5+ years of software engineering experience building production systems (APIs, services, data pipelines, or enterprise integrations)
Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field, or equivalent work experience
Strong proficiency in at least one production language such as Python, C#, Java, or similar

Experience integrating third-party APIs and services; strong understanding of distributed systems, REST/JSON, and authentication/authorization patterns.Hands-on experience implementing LLM-based solutions (prompting, structured outputs, tool/function calling) and/or ML-enabled services
Awareness of LLMOps/MLOps practices: versioning, evaluation, monitoring, incident response, and change control
Experience with cloud platforms (AWS and/or Azure) and production operations (secrets management, logging/monitoring, cost controls)
Strong engineering hygiene: source control, code review, automated testing, CI/CD, and performance monitoring
Understanding of AI risk and security considerations (prompt injection, data privacy/PII handling, vendor/model risk management) in regulated environments
Effective verbal and written communication skills; ability to translate business needs into technical solutions

job_highlights.title: Responsibilities
items: This role will be instrumental in shaping how we design, build, deploy, and operate AI-powered solutions safely and responsibly

The ideal candidate is pragmatic and hands-on—focused on putting AI into production (not research-only)—and comfortable building repeatable patterns, playbooks, and guardrails from the ground up.ResponsibilitiesImplement AI-enabled features, services, and APIs that integrate into existing enterprise workflows and applications, while adhering to established engineering, architecture, and security practices
Design and build integration patterns for external AI services (LLMs and ML APIs), including secure data handling, access controls, and auditability
Develop and maintain retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) solutions for document-heavy workflows (e.g., submissions, endorsements, claims documentation) using enterprise data sources
Collaborate with Architecture and Engineering to support the implementation of an Agentic AI platform reference architecture and implementation
Create reusable AI components including Agentic Platform components to accelerate delivery across multiple use cases
Partner with architecture, engineering, data, and business stakeholders to translate needs into solution designs, requirements, and delivery plans
Establish AI engineering best practices for testing and evaluation (quality, safety, regression testing), and incorporate them into CI/CD pipelines
Implement monitoring and observability for AI solutions (latency, cost, quality signals, guardrail events) and define operational runbooks
Collaborate with others to support AI governance controls (vendor/model intake, risk reviews, documentation, and change management)
Contribute to security hardening for AI systems, including safeguards against prompt injection, data leakage, and misuse
Document designs and deliver knowledge transfer to broaden internal capability and reduce reliance on external partners over time
Stay up to date with AI engineering tools, platforms, and patterns and recommend pragmatic adoption aligned to business value and risk posture
